preserved_exact_error: ValueError: Expected a list or a dict for 'columns', got <class 'tuple'> instead.
material_findings: The exact failure is reproducible from committed code: the loader passes a tuple-valued columns selector to PyArrow; the pre-data tests imported PyArrow but never exercised one valid verified-buffer parse, so production readiness was overstated.

The controller collapses integrity, numerical-degeneracy, parser, and implementation errors into DEVELOPMENT_PIPELINE_FAILURE, so the frozen DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE and NUMERICAL_DEGENERACY_FAILURE precedence is not executable.

Session construction evaluates each day independently while supplying DEVELOPMENT_END as the missing-row boundary and no later cross-session rows; wholly absent sessions and missing terminal rows can therefore be detected at the experiment boundary instead of the earliest later causal observation.

Target and recovery eligibility use ex-post session completeness before the recorded causal detection time, while a missing ordinary fill is triggered immediately at its expected timestamp; both can introduce future-informed quarantine behavior.

Simulation marks holdings before processing a simultaneous integrity trigger, does not prove every target was filled or cancelled, and its trace_reconciled predicate permits orphan target hashes, contrary to the frozen event-order and trace-completeness rules.
Baseline drawdown comparisons reuse each full-path maximum drawdown instead of recomputing drawdown on the exact common comparison panel and corresponding event slices.

The no_material_leakage, no_survivorship_contamination, and acceptance-gate-inheritance checks are hard-coded true rather than derived from validated evidence; the identified causal defects make the leakage assertion especially unsupported.
The audit preserves cs-ranking-ptu-data-audit-v1=DATA_NO_GO and btc-eth-causal-volatility-parity-rebalancing-v1=HISTORICAL_NO_GO_DEVELOPMENT/AUDIT_REJECTED unchanged.
methodology_assessment: The pipeline failure and absence of an economic result are confirmed, but the committed evaluator materially diverges from the frozen causal-detection, failure-precedence, trace-reconciliation, and baseline-panel contracts. This experiment cannot support DEVELOPMENT_GO, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, holdout access, candidate promotion, or any performance claim.
next_program_action: Terminalize this exact experiment as AUDIT_REJECTED while retaining its immutable DEVELOPMENT_PIPELINE_FAILURE evidence; do not repair, rerun, or open the holdout. Keep the overall program ACTIVE_RESEARCH and preregister the next genuinely distinct approved family supported by verified zero-cost data.
